user.title: Connect to the device
user.description: Enter the address of your Monoprice amplifier using the format socket://host:port (e.g. socket://192.168.1.250:8235).

snapshot.name: Snapshot
snapshot.description: Takes a snapshot of the media player zone.

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Restores a snapshot of the media player zone.

set_balance.name: Set balance
set_balance.description: Sets the balance level of the targeted zones.

level.name: Level
level.description: Integer from 0 to 20 inclusive, where 0 is -10 (left), 10 is center and 20 is +10 (right).

set_bass.name: Set bass
set_bass.description: Sets the bass level of the targeted zones.

set_treble.name: Set treble
set_treble.description: Sets the treble level of the targeted zones.

set_zone_source.name: Set zone source
set_zone_source.description: Sets the input source of the targeted zones by its numeric id.

set_all_zones_source.name: Set all zones source
set_all_zones_source.description: Sets the input source of every zone on every configured amplifier.
